control_flow: followInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70 (dim) then if the line tracker reads below 90 % curve left, else if it reads above 90 % curve right, else call avoidWalls; else (bright) call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT < 70 (dim) then if LEFT sees an obstacle turn right 20°, else if RIGHT sees an obstacle turn left 20°, else call driveInTheDark; else call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70 (dim) drive forward at 30 % without end; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if FRONT sees an obstacle stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black curve left (10/40), else curve right (40/10).

likely_intent.description: In the dark, follow a line if there is one under the robot and drive straight if there isn't; in the light, follow the line.
